answer: Require every new agent to lock a time-decaying stake bond before it can transact, released only after a rotating beacon committee of established peers attests its work over several epochs. A Sybil farmer must fund a separate bond per identity, and the bond cost rises with identities spawned in the same window, so cloning a meadow of fake agents costs more than the rewards they harvest. Quartz-hard collateral plus slow trust accumulation makes mass identity creation uneconomic.
